matching.clear_cache_confirm_with_count: Are you sure you want to clear {{count}} cached matches?
matching.configuration_reset_to_defaults_save_to: Configuration reset to defaults. Save to apply.
matching.desc_weight_for_category_match_alignment: Weight for category match alignment between listings
matching.desc_weight_for_geographic_proximity: Weight for geographic proximity between members
matching.desc_weight_for_listing_recency: Weight for how recently the listing was posted
matching.desc_weight_for_mutual_exchange_potentia: Weight for mutual exchange potential between members
matching.desc_weight_for_profile_completeness_and: Weight for profile completeness and rating quality in the matching algorithm
matching.desc_weight_for_skill_complementarity: Weight for skill complementarity between member listings
matching.match_approvals_desc: Review and approve or reject matches generated by the smart matching engine
matching.matching_analytics_desc: View match score distributions, approval rates, and distance data
matching.matching_config_desc: Configure algorithm weights and settings for the smart matching engine
matching.no_matching_data_desc: No matching data is available yet
matching.placeholder_explain_why_this_match_is_be: Explain Why This Match is Being Rejected...
matching.please_provide_a_reason_for_rejection: Please provide a reason for rejection
matching.proximity_bands_desc: Define distance bands used to score geographic proximity between members
matching.reset_defaults_confirm: Reset every setting on this page to its default? Nothing is saved until you save your changes.
matching.smart_matching_enabled_desc: When this is off, members get no matches, nothing new is stored and no match alerts are sent.
matching.smart_matching_overview_desc: Overview of smart matching activity, approvals, and match scores
matching.hard_distance_gate_desc: Remote and hybrid listings are exempt; physical listings beyond the max distance are excluded from matches
matching.missing_coords_mode_desc: How to match members who haven't set a location
matching.missing_coords_mode_remote_only: Remote matches only + prompt to set location
matching.dormancy_days_desc: Days of inactivity before a member is excluded from matching (0 = off)
matching.owner_dismissal_threshold_desc: Number of dismissals by a listing owner before similar matches are suppressed
matching.ai_semantic_matching_desc: Use AI-generated embeddings to improve match relevance beyond keyword overlap
matching.ai_match_explanations_desc: Generate a short natural-language explanation for top matches
matching.ai_listing_reading_desc: The AI notes what help each listing is about, so listings in other languages or other words can still meet.
matching.ai_wider_reading: AI reads skills, volunteering and events
matching.ai_wider_reading_desc: The same for profile skills, volunteering opportunities and events. A skill is sent without saying whose it is.
matching.ai_discovery: AI looks for matches the engine missed
matching.ai_discovery_desc: For each listing, the AI is shown the community's open offers or requests and picks the real fits. Distance and safeguarding rules still apply.
matching.ai_alert_check: AI checks a match before the email
matching.ai_alert_check_desc: Before a member is emailed about a strong match, the AI can hold it back if it is plainly a mistake. If the AI does not answer, the email goes as usual.
matching.explanation_top_n_desc: How many top matches per member get an AI-generated explanation (1-10)
matching.gate_impact_desc: How location data quality and matching gates affect the eligible pool
matching.label_degraded_members_desc: Members matched with reduced accuracy due to missing location data
matching.feedback_reasons_desc: Why members are dismissing suggested matches
matching.pillar_averages_desc: Average score contribution per matching pillar across recent matches
matching.clear_cache_confirm_with_count_one: Are you sure you want to clear {{count}} cached matches?
matching.clear_cache_confirm_with_count_other: Are you sure you want to clear {{count}} cached matches?
matching.scoring_method_v2_note: A match score is built from three things. Move a slider to make that one count for more.
matching.scoring_method_v1_note: This community uses the older scoring method, which weighs six things. They should add up to 100%.
matching.pillar_relevance_desc: How well what is offered fits what is needed: category, skills and description.
matching.pillar_feasibility_desc: How practical it is: distance, availability and how recently the other member was active.
matching.pillar_trust_desc: How dependable the other member looks: reviews, verification and exchanges they have completed.
matching.pillars_scaled_note: The three are balanced against each other automatically, so they do not need to add up to 100%.
matching.error_pillars_all_zero: At least one of the three must be above 0%.
matching.error_band_ascending: Enter a distance above 0 km that is further than the band before it.
matching.error_hot_below_min: This cannot be lower than the minimum match score.
matching.error_max_distance_range: Enter a distance from 1 to 20,000 km.
matching.error_fix_fields: Please correct the fields marked in red, then save again.
matching.min_match_score_desc: The lowest score shown to members who have not chosen their own minimum.
